```lean
theorem lg_target {τ : ℂ} (hτ : 0 < τ.im) (n : ℤ) : ‖Complex.exp (↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs := by
  rw [Complex.norm_exp, Real.exp_neg]
  have h : (↑n ^ 2 * τ).im = ↑n ^ 2 * τ.im := by simp
  rw [h]
  simp only [Real.exp_mul, Real.exp_zero, Real.pi_mul]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp
  apply Real.le_mul_of_nonneg_right
  apply Real.mul_nonneg
  · exact (Real.nonneg_of_nonneg_one _).mul_nonneg (Real.zero_le (Real.ofNat _) : 0 ≤ ↑n ^ 2)
  · exact Real.le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.le_zero_iff.mp hτ) (Real.ofNat_nonneg _)
```
